sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online (also online with a university library login)
sources.note: Nothing. Phonology sketch covers syllable/root structure, consonants, vowels, tone (three contrastive lexical tones H, L, HL; downdrift/downstep/upstep; spreading; polar tone; lexical tone on nouns; grammatical tone on verbs), vowel harmony, nasalisation. 'stress'/'accent' occur only as English 'sentence accent', 'it should be stressed that', and tone diacritics. No statement on word stress or its absence.
